title: A Horizon for the Passage
author: Yara Sterling
blurb: Hazel Yarrow, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
